name: Composio bridge (optional)
description: Optional bridge to Composio's hosted tool catalogue. Does nothing without COMPOSIO_API_KEY in the daemon's environment. First-party Apps and MCP are enough for OpenAg; this is only a convenience.

tools.name: find_tools
tools.description: Search Composio's tool catalogue (by text and optionally a toolkit slug such as github). Returns slugs and descriptions only. Sends the query to Composio.

tools.name: run_tool
tools.description: Run ONE Composio tool by its slug (for example GITHUB_CREATE_AN_ISSUE) with a JSON object of arguments. This acts on your connected accounts at Composio: every call asks for approval.

arguments_json.description: A JSON object with the tool's arguments.
